correctness.rationale: Almansi plus spherical harmonics gives precisely two radial solutions for each degree. The displayed two-by-two positive definite Gram matrices have determinant ratio \(t^{p+2}\) and trace \(t^{p/2}U/4\); Vieta gives the exact roots. Strict radial measure tilting proves both m-orderings. For fixed d,t, trace/product yield \(m^{\pm2}t^m\) branches and cutoff degrees \((L\pm2\log L)/\ell+O(1)\); exact harmonic multiplicities give the sharp difference and cancellation. The standalone checker ran 2,203 finite assertions from the new package, but the analytic argument alone covers all m.

value.rationale: Concentric concentration for biharmonic L2 solutions is a canonical higher-order analogue of the classical harmonic restriction problem. Two radial degrees per spherical type create a nontrivial spectral splitting with an exact determinant identity. The sharp weighted counting difference detects a log-log correction concealed in the total Weyl-type count; this distinguishes independent modes and informs stable truncation of biharmonic data. The claim is a natural full classification with precise asymptotics, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice or software-only calculation.
